requirements.title: Severity-Tagged Diagnostic Logging API
requirements.description: The log library shall expose diagnostic logging functions for debug, info, warning, and error severities.
requirements.rationale: Standalone diagnostic logging API; no L1 SYS parent. juno_log is a project-wide utility predating the SYS L1 set, providing a diagnostic event/error logging API distinct from the SD mission logger (mlog_lib).

requirements.title: Severity Prefix in Output
requirements.description: The log library shall prefix every emitted record with its severity label.
requirements.rationale: Standalone diagnostic logging API; no L1 SYS parent. juno_log is a project-wide utility predating the SYS L1 set. Severity prefix yields machine-parseable diagnostic output structure.

requirements.title: Formatted Diagnostic Message Support
requirements.description: The log library shall accept a printf-style format string with variadic arguments for each diagnostic record.
requirements.rationale: Standalone diagnostic logging API; no L1 SYS parent. juno_log is a project-wide utility predating the SYS L1 set. Diagnostic records carry status/error context that callers compose at the log site.

requirements.title: Bounded Output Buffer
requirements.description: The log library shall bound each formatted record to a fixed maximum length without heap allocation.
requirements.rationale: PM brief and SYS NFR: bounded memory; no heap; truncate rather than allocate.

requirements.title: Status Return on Each Call
requirements.description: The log library shall return a status code from every diagnostic logging call.
requirements.rationale: Standalone diagnostic logging API; no L1 SYS parent. juno_log is a project-wide utility predating the SYS L1 set. Callers must observe whether a diagnostic emission succeeded or failed.

requirements.title: Identical API Across Platforms
requirements.description: The log library shall present an identical public API on the POSIX and Pico2 builds.
requirements.rationale: PM brief: POSIX vs Pico2 may differ in sink, but interface is identical for SITL equivalence.

requirements.title: Platform-Configurable Diagnostic Sink
requirements.description: The log library shall direct diagnostic output to a platform-specific sink configured at build time.
requirements.rationale: PM brief and L2 design FLAG-1 disposition (PM 2026-05-04): POSIX sink is stderr; Pico2 sink is UART (with optional RTT via LOG_LIB_PICO2_USE_RTT); sink choice is per-platform implementation.

requirements.title: Separation From Mission Logging
requirements.description: The log library shall not write diagnostic records to the SD card mission log.
requirements.rationale: Scope-separation declaration: keeps juno_log distinct from mlog_lib (cross-reference SW-REQ-SYS-022 which governs SD mission log content). juno_log is the diagnostic logger; mission logging is a separate concern owned by mlog_lib. No L1 SYS parent applies to this scope boundary.
